definitions.explanation: The white coat worn by doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and laboratory workers, and by extension a symbol of the medical profession.

examples.japanese: {白衣|はくい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a white coat.

examples.japanese: {白衣|はくい}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってきた→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: A doctor in a white coat came in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白衣|はくい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧メガネ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につけ→身につく：31476_minitsuku⟧た。
examples.english: Before the experiment, the students put on lab coats and safety goggles.

notes:
Also read びゃくえ in Buddhist contexts (the white robe of pilgrims and the dead); in everyday use it is はくい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白衣|はくい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a white coat
- {白衣|はくい}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: in a white coat
- {白衣|はくい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天使|てんし}→天使：12174_tenshi⟧: angel in white (a set phrase for nurses)
- {白衣|はくい}⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧: white-coat hypertension
